note: Original description (Eutermes (Grallatotermes) luzonicus), with large and small forms of both the soldier and the worker. The OCR has damaged some figures; values that could not be confirmed are not listed.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: (Placed in the subgenus Grallatotermes of Eutermes in the original, with two size forms.) Major soldier: head dark brown; abdomen deep yellow and glossy. Head with extremely sparse setae; abdominal tergites densely covered with fine hairs, the posterior margins of the last 2—3 tergites with longer setae. Head broadly oval; nasus conical, its front surface forming a single arc with the front of the head, the base slightly swollen dorsally; mandibles short at the tip; antennae 13-segmented, segments 3 and 4 longer than segment 2; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin slightly concave in the middle, posterior margin rounded. Measurements: body length 4.00 mm; head including nasus 1.78—1.81 mm; head length (without mandibles) 1.06 mm; head width 1.16—1.22 mm; pronotum width 0.56 mm. Minor soldier: head and abdominal tergites almost smooth, setae extremely sparse; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 almost as long as segment 2. Measurements: body length 3.50 mm; head length (without nasus) 1.00 mm; head width 1.00 mm; pronotum width 0.50 mm; the head-plus-nasus figure is damaged in the original (the OCR reads 'O5') and is not listed because it could not be confirmed.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head chestnut-brown with sparse setae; abdominal tergites finely hairy with longer hairs posteriorly. Head square, posterior margin rounded; cephalic sutures clear; base of the postclypeus far shorter than half its width, slightly convex; antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin bilobed. Measurements: body length 5.00 mm; head width 1.25 mm; pronotum width 0.78 mm. Minor worker: head dark brown, the transverse band distinctly paler; head coarsely hairy, abdominal tergites densely covered with fine hairs and a row of setae at the posterior margin; cephalic sutures very clear; antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 equal to segment 3, segment 4 far shorter than segment 3; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins rounded, not concave in the middle. Measurements: head width 0.94 mm; pronotum width 0.44 mm (the body length figure is damaged in the original and not listed).

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Locality: Los Baños, Luzon, collected by Professor Baker. Alate unknown.
